session.title: Eliezer Yudkowsky's AI Doom Position: Core Arguments and Critiques
session.question: What are the most coherent intuitive arguments for why Eliezer believes AI will kill everyone, and what critiques truly poke at foundations - especially the tool-AI / human augmentation alternative?

sources.title: AGI Ruin: A List of Lethalities
sources.found_via: Web search for Eliezer's core doom arguments
sources.relevance: THE primary source - Eliezer's master list of why AGI kills everyone

sources.title: If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies
sources.found_via: Web search; book-length expansion of AGI Ruin arguments
sources.status_detail: Read via summary at ai-frontiers.org and Asterisk review
sources.relevance: Book-length expansion of the doom case, with evolution/peacock analogies and documented AI deception cases

sources.title: Reply to Holden on 'Tool AI'
sources.found_via: Web search for Yudkowsky's response to tool AI argument

sources.title: Contra Yudkowsky on AI Doom
